Yash film 'Toxic' sees strong box office opening, then a dip

The Yash-starrer film 'Toxic' had a strong opening at the box office, with advance bookings reportedly earning crores and first-day collections estimated to reach ₹20 crore. Some reports indicated the film crossed the ₹100 crore mark on its first day in India. However, by the second day, collections saw a significant drop of over 60%, making it difficult to earn ₹50 crore on that day. The film has crossed ₹190 crore worldwide by day 4 and ₹200 crore by day 5, though its Saturday performance showed a sharp slowdown.
